entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. Yes, I... I think I need to return something? I ordered a helmet and it's just... it's not right. I'm a bit confused by the whole process.
I can certainly help you look into a return. To start, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
A preference, I guess? The color is much brighter than it looked online. I thought it was a dark green, but it's almost neon. It's just... a lot.
I understand, sometimes the screen can show colors a bit differently. Can I get the order number from you?

Um, let me see... it's VF88612. Honestly, the website was a little overwhelming. The box is still unopened, I haven't even touched it. I'm just worried about safety and getting the right gear. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I'm here to help. I see the order right here. It looks like it was delivered 23 days ago. Let me just confirm the policy for you.
Oh no, is that too long? I'm sorry, I get so behind on things.

Not at all. For a standard item like this helmet, you are well within our 90-day return window. I can go ahead and approve this return for you immediately. I'll email you a prepaid shipping label right now.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! Thank you so much, Alex. You've made this so much easier.

You're very welcome. The email is on its way. Just print the label, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, you'll see a full refund within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's perfect. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
